subject.title: refactor(codex): raise app-server floor to 0.142, drop range compat, fix deferred spawn_agent steering

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally reject custom Codex app-server binaries older than 0.142.0 in this PR?
rationale: The source and upstream checks support the refactor, but rejecting older custom app-server commands is a compatibility decision that should be explicit because it can stop existing operator setups at startup.

options.title: Accept the 0.142 floor
options.body: Fix the docs formatting and merge the refactor with the documented startup rejection for custom app-server binaries below 0.142.0.

options.title: Preserve older custom binaries
options.body: Restore the older compatibility paths or keep the lower floor until a migration/deprecation path is chosen.

options.title: Pause for upgrade proof
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers get broader upgrade evidence for custom app-server deployments.

recommendation.title: Accept the 0.142 floor
recommendation.body: Fix the docs formatting and merge the refactor with the documented startup rejection for custom app-server binaries below 0.142.0.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest current-main owner signal for the Codex app-server files and the PR already carries the maintainer label.
